name: Chaos Devie
description: Erratique brouillant les senseurs adverses par des mouvements aléatoires détournant les attaques loin des alliés de l'Incursion.

subject.archetype: Chaos Devie - Erratic Combat Specialist of the Dissonant Incursion

loadout.armor_outfit: Tattered military armor fused with glitching shadow fragments, plates bent and warped by spatial distortion, floating fabric scraps defying gravity around limbs, exposed patches of scarred flesh, joints locked at impossible angles, shadow tendrils detaching physically from the body, chromatic aberration glitching effect constantly flickering across the silhouette
loadout.arsenal: Obsidian-violet energy blade that phases between solid and dislocated states, floating shards of crystallized psychic energy orbiting erratically, weapon segments occasionally separating and rejoining in impossible configurations

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist in explosive action stance, body coiled with kinetic tension, weapon raised and crackling with corrupted energy, mid-motion blur suggesting chaotic unpredictable movement patterns, fragments of reality visibly distorting around the moving figure, multiple overlapping afterimages showing different combat poses simultaneously
attitude.emotion: Manic battle fury mixed with eldritch detachment, eyes fully revulsed showing only whites, mouth frozen in silent scream of transcendent violence, aura of psychological terror radiating outward

palette_names.name: Deep Violet
palette_names.role: Corrupted energy accents and glitch effects

palette_names.name: Sickly Flesh Gray
palette_names.role: Exposed wounds and diseased tissue highlights

palette_names.name: Magenta Neon
palette_names.role: Energy crackling and reality fracture lines

palette_names.name: Dried Blood Red
palette_names.role: Scarified details and combat damage accents

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic discordant multi-source lighting with violet-black energy auras, fractured ambient light showing conflicting sources, objects illuminated by celestial bodies that should not coexist
color_and_light.mood: Oppressive cosmic dread, reality-defining madness, chaotic violent energy

camera.angle: Low angle dutch tilt emphasizing chaotic unstable composition, slight zoom to show both character and collapsing environment fragments

scenography.setting: Reality collapse zone - buildings existing simultaneously as intact ruins and rubble, ground fractured revealing layered parallel battlefields underneath like corrupt image files stacked, sky displaying conflicting celestial bodies (burning sun overlapping frozen stars), gravity vectors pointing in multiple directions creating debris falling upward sideways and downward in different spatial zones
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Air fracturing like broken glass, chromatic aberration glitches pulsing across the entire scene, floating debris orbiting chaotically, psychic energy tendrils cracking through dimensional barriers, reality distortion ripples emanating from the combatant, holographic static and corruption artifacts overlaid on the environment
